Lunch on board

Sunset Felucca Ride

Day 5 – Disembarkation & Optional Abu Simbel Tour
Disembarkation
Optional: Visit Abu Simbel Temples (8-9 hours by land or 5 hours by flight round trip)
Departure transfer to airport, train station, or hotel
Inclusions & Exclusions
Inclusion
We provide seamless pickup and drop-off services at both Luxor International Airport (LXR) and Aswan International Airport (ASW).
04 or 03 nights’ accommodation on board the Nile cruises. on FB basis.
Meet and assist service upon arrival & departure.
Assistance of our personnel during your stay and excursions.
All transfers are made by a modern, air-conditioned, private deluxe vehicle.
All Nile Cruise excursions, as mentioned in the itinerary private.
Entrance fees to all sights in and between Luxor and Aswan.
Exclusion
Any Extra meals and beverages.
Personal expenses.
Tipping.
Optional tours.
Notes:- 
Rates to be applied for Standard Cabins (Main deck). A supplement to be added for bookings in Upper Deck cabins  
Children Policy
Less than 06years old: will be accommodated free of charge sharing parents’ cabin
From 6years till 11.99 years: Sharing parent’s cabins and will be charged as a half adult with a maximum of one child.
Children from 12 years & over will be charged full fare.
In case of 01 Child between 06 and 11.99 years accommodated with one adult only, cabin will be charged as 01 Double cabin.
Other language Guide: 
Guides speaking other language than English can be provided subject to availability with supplement of USD 200.00 per cruise trip

Breakfast on board
Optional Tours:

Disembarkation
Optional: Visit Abu Simbel Temples (8-9 hours by land or 5 hours by flight round trip)
Departure transfer to airport, train station, or hotel
Inclusions & Exclusions
Inclusion
We provide seamless pickup and drop-off services at both Luxor International Airport (LXR) and Aswan International Airport (ASW).
04 or 03 nights’ accommodation on board the Nile cruises. on FB basis.
Meet and assist service upon arrival & departure.
Assistance of our personnel during your stay and excursions.

Entrance fees to all sights in and between Luxor and Aswan.
Exclusion
Any Extra meals and beverages.
Personal expenses.
Tipping.
Optional tours.

Children Policy
Less than 06years old: will be accommodated free of charge sharing parents’ cabin
From 6years till 11.99 years: Sharing parent’s cabins and will be charged as a half adult with a maximum of one child.

In case of 01 Child between 06 and 11.99 years accommodated with one adult only, cabin will be charged as 01 Double cabin.
